fixes.reason: The pack read "10-foot-radius centred on you", which places the circle correctly and is invisible to everything else. `emanationIsLive` asks `/emanation/i` of the area string, so the one word that was missing is the word that decides whether the area follows its caster and whether standing in it is what grants the bonus. Cast it and the ward stayed on the square you cast it from while you walked away — the exact defect Graham reported against Bless on 27 August, surviving in a spell nobody had cast yet. The printed line is "Area 10-foot-emanation".

The pack read `false`, and that single flag closed three doors at once. `resolveAction` only registers an active-spell entry when a spell is sustained or PP-locked, so Protective Ward left NO record of having been cast: no entry on the Magic tab, nothing for the Sustain a Spell action to target, and — since the emanation record hangs off that entry — no live emanation either. The spell says "You can Sustain the Spell each round" in its own second sentence.

NOT "duration", which is the one that would have been wrong in the dangerous direction. A "duration" sustain is what keeps its spell alive, and `sustainedLapses` ends such a spell two rounds after the last Sustain — which would have killed a ward whose printed duration is a flat minute. Lightning Storm and Spiritual Weapon already carry "round" for exactly this shape: the duration is the spell's own, and a Sustain buys the thing the text names. Here it buys five feet. Graham's ruling, 28 August 2026: the minute runs regardless.

DECLARED, because it was prose. "Sustain each round to extend the aura's radius by 5 ft (max 30 ft)" sat in a note effect — text for a person to read, wired to nothing, so sustaining the ward could never have widened it. The sentence stays as a note; the two numbers now live where `spellGrowth` can read them and an author can change them without a regex learning to parse English.

The pack sold "+2 PP: status bonus increases by 5 (max +25)" — five times the printed option, and unlike the other three faults this one was LIVE: `aggregateWarpSelection` reads bonusValue and bonusMax, so eight Power Points bought a +25 status bonus to DB. That is not a spell being weaker than the book says, it is the best defensive effect in the game hiding behind a typo. Graham confirmed the printed reading on 28 August 2026: +1 per 2 PP, capped at +5.

fixes.to:
You emit a radiant aura of protective magic that envelops you and your allies. Within the area, you all benefit from a +1 status bonus to your DB. You can Sustain the Spell each round to extend the radius of the aura by 5 feet, up to a maximum of 30 feet.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: status bonus increases by 1 (max +5).
fixes.reason: The description repeated the wrong warp in words, so the card and the tooltip agreed with each other and both disagreed with the book. Corrected alongside the mods rather than after them: two copies of a number are the hazard this project keeps meeting, and leaving the prose behind would have left one.
